content: Custom/proprietary SSO integrations most commonly fail via: missing or skipped signature/token validation, wildcard or loosely-validated redirect URIs, trusting client-decoded token claims instead of server-verified ones, and session lifetimes that don't match token/claim lifetimes. Recommended mitigation: always verify server-side over TLS, reject on any validation failure with a generic 401, normalize claims from the verified response only, and treat the identity provider's example/sample code as unsafe by default (must be reviewed line by line).
